name: Modash API
description: Modash is an influencer marketing and social media data API providing discovery, analytics, and raw data access for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube creators. It includes influencer search, profile reports, audience overlap analysis, collaborations tracking, and AI-powered search capabilities.
